Tune this machine's devices ahead of time, so first runs don't stop to benchmark

```text
dspk autotune [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

- **`--channels <CHANNELS>`**: default `32 64 128 384`  
  Channel counts to tune
- **`--samples <SAMPLES>`**: default `8192 32768 131072 524288`  
  Samples per channel to tune
